meta.title: Ashes of the Dream
meta.description: Tear this carefully-crafted dream to pieces without mercy. Let this farce come to an end.

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

units.rawText: Electra swings her dagger and blocks Eos' attack again in exchange for her already half-destroyed arm.
units.displayText: Electra swings her dagger and blocks Eos' attack again in exchange for her already half-destroyed arm.

spans.text: Electra swings her dagger and blocks Eos' attack again in exchange for her already half-destroyed arm.

units.displayText: The brown-haired Sanctifier seizes on Eos' hesitation and grabs a nearby puppet, cutting its arm off and sticking it onto the severed stump.

units.rawText: Both stump and limb seem to be drawn to each other and merge like they have a will of their own, quickly fusing together as Eos watches in shock.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Electra thinks nothing of it. She nonchalantly limbers up her freshly-reattached arm, reflexively opening and clenching her fist, examining how well it syncs up with her body and laughing as she notices that her arms are of different lengths now.

units.rawText: Is there a need to go this far?
units.displayText: Is there a need to go this far?

spans.text: Is there a need to go this far?

units.rawText: This is our choice. All this is because we share the same wish as Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: This is our choice. All this is because we share the same wish as Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: This is our choice. All this is because we share the same wish as Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: ...Electra, you should not be bound here by Eosphorus' twisted will.
units.displayText: ...Electra, you should not be bound here by Eosphorus' twisted will.

spans.text: ...Electra, you should not be bound here by Eosphorus' twisted will.

units.rawText: Once everything is over, Angelus and I will cleanse your Sacred Canon, but right now...
units.displayText: Once everything is over, Angelus and I will cleanse your Sacred Canon, but right now...

spans.text: Once everything is over, Angelus and I will cleanse your Sacred Canon, but right now...

units.rawText: Eos' determination transforms into a shining radiance in her palm.
units.displayText: Eos' determination transforms into a shining radiance in her palm.

spans.text: Eos' determination transforms into a shining radiance in her palm.

units.rawText: I must defeat you and stop Eosphorus.
units.displayText: I must defeat you and stop Eosphorus.

units.displayText: You? Defeat me?

Defeat
me?

units.rawText: Electra is clearly unhappy as she enunciates each word, gathering like-minded puppets around her. They gather behind her in silence, exuding the same bloodlust as she does.

units.rawText: Your operands will be depleted before you defeat us. Therefore, you are the one who will be defeated.
units.displayText: Your operands will be depleted before you defeat us. Therefore, you are the one who will be defeated.

spans.text: Your operands will be depleted before you defeat us. Therefore, you are the one who will be defeated.

units.rawText: Give it a try, then.
units.displayText: Give it a try, then.

spans.text: Give it a try, then.

units.displayText: She leaps back, raising a fingertip and gathering starlight.

spans.text: She leaps back, raising a fingertip and gathering starlight.

units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.displayText: Falling stars crash down from the skies, instantly piercing through the bodies of several puppets who did not dodge in time.

spans.text: Falling stars crash down from the skies, instantly piercing through the bodies of several puppets who did not dodge in time.

units.rawText: Eos...

units.displayText: Starlight Burst!

units.displayText: As the puppets raise their claws to attack, they are torn apart by sheer force and shredded into pieces, which dissolve into operands and vanish into the air.

spans.text: As the puppets raise their claws to attack, they are torn apart by sheer force and shredded into pieces, which dissolve into operands and vanish into the air.

units.rawText: I've never seen that move before...
units.displayText: I've never seen that move before...

spans.text: I've never seen that move before...

units.rawText: She re-creates a weapon with operands as she focuses her attention on the blade of starlight at Eos' fingertip. Her eyes are filled with a mix of emotions.
units.displayText: She re-creates a weapon with operands as she focuses her attention on the blade of starlight at Eos' fingertip. Her eyes are filled with a mix of emotions.

spans.text: She re-creates a weapon with operands as she focuses her attention on the blade of starlight at Eos' fingertip. Her eyes are filled with a mix of emotions.

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: I learned this skill after awakening from the fragment. I'm not skilled at swordplay, and close-range combat is not my style.
units.displayText: I learned this skill after awakening from the fragment. I'm not skilled at swordplay, and close-range combat is not my style.

spans.text: I learned this skill after awakening from the fragment. I'm not skilled at swordplay, and close-range combat is not my style.

units.rawText: But against puppets without operand shields, it can at least serve as a form of basic self-defense.
units.displayText: But against puppets without operand shields, it can at least serve as a form of basic self-defense.

spans.text: But against puppets without operand shields, it can at least serve as a form of basic self-defense.

units.rawText: And here I thought you would stick with your techniques from the past... It seems you are truly determined to forget us.
units.displayText: And here I thought you would stick with your techniques from the past... It seems you are truly determined to forget us.

spans.text: And here I thought you would stick with your techniques from the past... It seems you are truly determined to forget us.

units.rawText: Moving on doesn't mean forgetting what has been, Electra.
units.displayText: Moving on doesn't mean forgetting what has been, Electra.

spans.text: Moving on doesn't mean forgetting what has been, Electra.

units.rawText: Electra ignores Eos' reply. She simply whets her blades against each other and vanishes into the press of puppets.
units.displayText: Electra ignores Eos' reply. She simply whets her blades against each other and vanishes into the press of puppets.

spans.text: Electra ignores Eos' reply. She simply whets her blades against each other and vanishes into the press of puppets.

units.rawText: Show me what other tricks you have in store, Eos.
units.displayText: Show me what other tricks you have in store, Eos.

spans.text: Show me what other tricks you have in store, Eos.

units.rawText: On the other side of the battle, Persicaria's fight with Atlas is nowhere as gaudy or brilliant.
units.displayText: On the other side of the battle, Persicaria's fight with Atlas is nowhere as gaudy or brilliant.

spans.text: On the other side of the battle, Persicaria's fight with Atlas is nowhere as gaudy or brilliant.

units.rawText: It is a naked clash of blade against blade, with both sides determined not to yield in the slightest.
units.displayText: It is a naked clash of blade against blade, with both sides determined not to yield in the slightest.

spans.text: It is a naked clash of blade against blade, with both sides determined not to yield in the slightest.

units.rawText: <size=40>Take this!</size>
units.displayText: Take this!

spans.text: Take this!

units.rawText: A greatsword driven by sheer brute force bears down on the girl. Persicaria raises her weapon to block it.
units.displayText: A greatsword driven by sheer brute force bears down on the girl. Persicaria raises her weapon to block it.

spans.text: A greatsword driven by sheer brute force bears down on the girl. Persicaria raises her weapon to block it.

units.rawText: It is only when their edges are about to touch that she realizes just how precipitous the gap between their respective strengths is. She is forced to pull back and sidestep, deflecting the strike to the side and using the force of the blow to withdraw.
units.displayText: It is only when their edges are about to touch that she realizes just how precipitous the gap between their respective strengths is. She is forced to pull back and sidestep, deflecting the strike to the side and using the force of the blow to withdraw.

spans.text: It is only when their edges are about to touch that she realizes just how precipitous the gap between their respective strengths is. She is forced to pull back and sidestep, deflecting the strike to the side and using the force of the blow to withdraw.

units.displayText: Crash—

units.rawText: The missed strike excavates a deep pit in the ground. Atlas doesn't seem bothered by this; instead, he simply wipes away the bright red operands from the wound he had just taken.
units.displayText: The missed strike excavates a deep pit in the ground. Atlas doesn't seem bothered by this; instead, he simply wipes away the bright red operands from the wound he had just taken.

spans.text: The missed strike excavates a deep pit in the ground. Atlas doesn't seem bothered by this; instead, he simply wipes away the bright red operands from the wound he had just taken.

units.rawText: Haha, that was a good one!
units.displayText: Haha, that was a good one!

spans.text: Haha, that was a good one!

units.rawText: He hefts his greatsword back onto his shoulder and smiles.
units.displayText: He hefts his greatsword back onto his shoulder and smiles.

spans.text: He hefts his greatsword back onto his shoulder and smiles.

units.rawText: But that's not all your strength, is it? Persicaria, you don't need to hold back here, do you?
units.displayText: But that's not all your strength, is it? Persicaria, you don't need to hold back here, do you?

spans.text: But that's not all your strength, is it? Persicaria, you don't need to hold back here, do you?

units.rawText: ...That's up to me. It has nothing to do with you.
units.displayText: ...That's up to me. It has nothing to do with you.

spans.text: ...That's up to me. It has nothing to do with you.

units.rawText: How cold. Here I thought you ought to be the sociable sort, seeing how you get along so well with <cmdr>.
units.displayText: How cold. Here I thought you ought to be the sociable sort, seeing how you get along so well with {교수}.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, you look like you've been in pain since just now... Are you really alright?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, you look like you've been in pain since just now... Are you really alright?

spans.text: Speaking of which, you look like you've been in pain since just now... Are you really alright?

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl does not reply. Instead, she dashes forward with lightning speed, her sword clashing against Atlas' massive blade as he brings it in front of himself.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl does not reply. Instead, she dashes forward with lightning speed, her sword clashing against Atlas' massive blade as he brings it in front of himself.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl does not reply. Instead, she dashes forward with lightning speed, her sword clashing against Atlas' massive blade as he brings it in front of himself.

units.rawText: Oh? Looks like I hit the nail on the head!
units.displayText: Oh? Looks like I hit the nail on the head!

spans.text: Oh? Looks like I hit the nail on the head!

units.rawText: Come on, give me everything you've got!
units.displayText: Come on, give me everything you've got!

spans.text: Come on, give me everything you've got!

units.rawText: The ponderous weapon dances like the wind in his hand, fending off each and every one of Persicaria's speedy attacks.
units.displayText: The ponderous weapon dances like the wind in his hand, fending off each and every one of Persicaria's speedy attacks.

spans.text: The ponderous weapon dances like the wind in his hand, fending off each and every one of Persicaria's speedy attacks.

units.rawText: Ngh, you're a tough one...
units.displayText: Ngh, you're a tough one...

spans.text: Ngh, you're a tough one...

units.rawText: Why, thank you!
units.displayText: Why, thank you!

spans.text: Why, thank you!

units.rawText: Persicaria pulls her sword back and adjusts her fighting stance.
units.displayText: Persicaria pulls her sword back and adjusts her fighting stance.

spans.text: Persicaria pulls her sword back and adjusts her fighting stance.

units.rawText: ...Aren't you going to use those puppets to sub in for you?
units.displayText: ...Aren't you going to use those puppets to sub in for you?

spans.text: ...Aren't you going to use those puppets to sub in for you?

units.rawText: I'll leave them for Electra. You're a tricky opponent, but I'd rather beat you fair and square, by myself.
units.displayText: I'll leave them for Electra. You're a tricky opponent, but I'd rather beat you fair and square, by myself.

spans.text: I'll leave them for Electra. You're a tricky opponent, but I'd rather beat you fair and square, by myself.

units.rawText: Is that so? Then I'll have to return that favor in kind.
units.displayText: Is that so? Then I'll have to return that favor in kind.

spans.text: Is that so? Then I'll have to return that favor in kind.

units.rawText: Their swords clash again, and the storm of operands they discharge around them swallows up all the nearby puppets.
units.displayText: Their swords clash again, and the storm of operands they discharge around them swallows up all the nearby puppets.

spans.text: Their swords clash again, and the storm of operands they discharge around them swallows up all the nearby puppets.

units.rawText: Eos does not pass up this opportunity; she gathers up her remaining operands as the puppets are thrown off balance.
units.displayText: Eos does not pass up this opportunity; she gathers up her remaining operands as the puppets are thrown off balance.

spans.text: Eos does not pass up this opportunity; she gathers up her remaining operands as the puppets are thrown off balance.

units.rawText: This is it!
units.displayText: This is it!

spans.text: This is it!

units.rawText: Shafts of starlight fall, destroying the puppets until Electra has nowhere to hide.
units.displayText: Shafts of starlight fall, destroying the puppets until Electra has nowhere to hide.

spans.text: Shafts of starlight fall, destroying the puppets until Electra has nowhere to hide.

units.rawText: I don't want to press you until you have nowhere to run, Electra. We'd just hurt each other for no reason that way. If you surrender now, there might still be a chance to restore your neural cloud's perceptions.
units.displayText: I don't want to press you until you have nowhere to run, Electra. We'd just hurt each other for no reason that way. If you surrender now, there might still be a chance to restore your neural cloud's perceptions.

spans.text: I don't want to press you until you have nowhere to run, Electra. We'd just hurt each other for no reason that way. If you surrender now, there might still be a chance to restore your neural cloud's perceptions.

units.rawText: <size=40>You're the one who should be surrendering, traitor!</size>
units.displayText: You're the one who should be surrendering, traitor!

spans.text: You're the one who should be surrendering, traitor!

units.rawText: Electra bellows angrily and summons all the remaining puppets to herself, then sends them all after Eos without holding back.
units.displayText: Electra bellows angrily and summons all the remaining puppets to herself, then sends them all after Eos without holding back.

spans.text: Electra bellows angrily and summons all the remaining puppets to herself, then sends them all after Eos without holding back.

units.rawText: As Eos raises her hand to summon more comets, several puppets hurl themselves into the attack before it can complete, heedless of the damage it causes them.
units.displayText: As Eos raises her hand to summon more comets, several puppets hurl themselves into the attack before it can complete, heedless of the damage it causes them.

units.rawText: This is the end!
units.displayText: This is the end!

units.rawText: ...Yes, it is.
units.displayText: ...Yes, it is.

spans.text: ...Yes, it is.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Electra is briefly stunned by a blinding flash. By the time she opens her eyes again, her limbs are immobilized by shafts of starlight that are impaling them.
units.displayText: Electra is briefly stunned by a blinding flash. By the time she opens her eyes again, her limbs are immobilized by shafts of starlight that are impaling them.

spans.text: Electra is briefly stunned by a blinding flash. By the time she opens her eyes again, her limbs are immobilized by shafts of starlight that are impaling them.

units.rawText: Ugh! Weren't... Weren't these already broken...
units.displayText: Ugh! Weren't... Weren't these already broken...

spans.text: Ugh! Weren't... Weren't these already broken...

units.rawText: Oh yes. The ones above me were broken, at least.
units.displayText: Oh yes. The ones above me were broken, at least.

spans.text: Oh yes. The ones above me were broken, at least.

units.rawText: ...But the ones that hit you came from below the ground.
units.displayText: ...But the ones that hit you came from below the ground.

spans.text: ...But the ones that hit you came from below the ground.

units.rawText: The white-haired Sanctifier raises her hand again and more rays of starlight erupt from the ground, piercing and destroying all the remaining puppets.
units.displayText: The white-haired Sanctifier raises her hand again and more rays of starlight erupt from the ground, piercing and destroying all the remaining puppets.

spans.text: The white-haired Sanctifier raises her hand again and more rays of starlight erupt from the ground, piercing and destroying all the remaining puppets.

units.rawText: This reflected starlight might not be as brilliant as the stars themselves, but it still functions as a capable weapon for the Professor.
units.displayText: This reflected starlight might not be as brilliant as the stars themselves, but it still functions as a capable weapon for the Professor.

spans.text: This reflected starlight might not be as brilliant as the stars themselves, but it still functions as a capable weapon for the Professor.

units.rawText: I didn't expect you to have a trick like that up your sleeve... Still, don't think you've won just yet.
units.displayText: I didn't expect you to have a trick like that up your sleeve... Still, don't think you've won just yet.

spans.text: I didn't expect you to have a trick like that up your sleeve... Still, don't think you've won just yet.

units.rawText: <size=40>Don't you dare hurt Electra!</size>
units.displayText: Don't you dare hurt Electra!

spans.text: Don't you dare hurt Electra!

units.displayText: Several arrows break the starlight shafts binding Electra, giving the latter a chance to struggle free.

spans.text: Several arrows break the starlight shafts binding Electra, giving the latter a chance to struggle free.

units.rawText: Alcyone.
units.displayText: Alcyone.

spans.text: Alcyone.

units.rawText: If you hurt Electra, I won't forgive you, even if you ARE Eos!
units.displayText: If you hurt Electra, I won't forgive you, even if you ARE Eos!

spans.text: If you hurt Electra, I won't forgive you, even if you ARE Eos!

units.displayText: The girl with steely eyes stands in front of Eos, preventing her from taking another step forward.

spans.text: The girl with steely eyes stands in front of Eos, preventing her from taking another step forward.

units.rawText: It's not like that! Your and Electra's Sacred Canon have been rewritten so your perception of things has been changed!
units.displayText: It's not like that! Your and Electra's Sacred Canon have been rewritten so your perception of things has been changed!

spans.text: It's not like that! Your and Electra's Sacred Canon have been rewritten so your perception of things has been changed!

units.rawText: Alcyone, our true enemy is Eosphorus!
units.displayText: Alcyone, our true enemy is Eosphorus!

spans.text: Alcyone, our true enemy is Eosphorus!

units.rawText: How can you even say that?! Lord Eosphorus is fighting for us!
units.displayText: How can you even say that?! Lord Eosphorus is fighting for us!

spans.text: How can you even say that?! Lord Eosphorus is fighting for us!

units.rawText: You're only standing against us because you've been deceived! Come to your senses and fight by our side! We should be friends, shouldn't we?
units.displayText: You're only standing against us because you've been deceived! Come to your senses and fight by our side! We should be friends, shouldn't we?

units.displayText: Electra! Are you alright?

spans.text: Electra! Are you alright?

units.displayText: What about Atlas? Have you taken care of your side?

spans.text: What about Atlas? Have you taken care of your side?

units.rawText: I've... pacified him. But as of now, we need to take care of these two.
units.displayText: I've... pacified him. But as of now, we need to take care of these two.

spans.text: I've... pacified him. But as of now, we need to take care of these two.

units.rawText: You're more familiar with how they attack than I am, so I'll work with you and create a chance for you to attack.
units.displayText: You're more familiar with how they attack than I am, so I'll work with you and create a chance for you to attack.

spans.text: You're more familiar with how they attack than I am, so I'll work with you and create a chance for you to attack.

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: Starlight shafts and arrows crystallize into existence on both sides.
units.displayText: Starlight shafts and arrows crystallize into existence on both sides.

spans.text: Starlight shafts and arrows crystallize into existence on both sides.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: As the projectiles collide in mid-air, Persicaria's sword cleaves through the air, clashing against Electra's thrusting blades.
units.displayText: As the projectiles collide in mid-air, Persicaria's sword cleaves through the air, clashing against Electra's thrusting blades.

spans.text: As the projectiles collide in mid-air, Persicaria's sword cleaves through the air, clashing against Electra's thrusting blades.

units.rawText: Urgh! Why are your operand levels higher than when we first met?!
units.displayText: Urgh! Why are your operand levels higher than when we first met?!

spans.text: Urgh! Why are your operand levels higher than when we first met?!

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll does not answer. Instead she replies with an operand-powered diagonal slash.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll does not answer. Instead she replies with an operand-powered diagonal slash.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll does not answer. Instead she replies with an operand-powered diagonal slash.

units.rawText: Electra quickly ducks away, but when she finds her footing, she is immediately assailed by a stabbing pain.
units.displayText: Electra quickly ducks away, but when she finds her footing, she is immediately assailed by a stabbing pain.

spans.text: Electra quickly ducks away, but when she finds her footing, she is immediately assailed by a stabbing pain.

units.rawText: Mind your step.
units.displayText: Mind your step.

spans.text: Mind your step.

units.rawText: ...Dammit!
units.displayText: ...Dammit!

spans.text: ...Dammit!

units.rawText: She angrily charges Eos, but then the starlight shafts at her fingertips flare and for a moment, everyone present is blinded.
units.displayText: She angrily charges Eos, but then the starlight shafts at her fingertips flare and for a moment, everyone present is blinded.

spans.text: She angrily charges Eos, but then the starlight shafts at her fingertips flare and for a moment, everyone present is blinded.

units.rawText: Ugh!
units.displayText: Ugh!

spans.text: Ugh!

units.rawText: It's useless!
units.displayText: It's useless!

spans.text: It's useless!

units.rawText: Electra is prepared for this, and she is not affected like she was before. Her vision restores itself just 0.3 seconds after it is whited out, and she slashes in Eos' direction, judging her distance purely by memory of her target's location.
units.displayText: Electra is prepared for this, and she is not affected like she was before. Her vision restores itself just 0.3 seconds after it is whited out, and she slashes in Eos' direction, judging her distance purely by memory of her target's location.

spans.text: Electra is prepared for this, and she is not affected like she was before. Her vision restores itself just 0.3 seconds after it is whited out, and she slashes in Eos' direction, judging her distance purely by memory of her target's location.

units.rawText: Tsk!
units.displayText: Tsk!

spans.text: Tsk!

units.rawText: The blow stabs into Persicaria's right shoulder. Her sword arm is rendered powerless and bright red operands gush from her wound.
units.displayText: The blow stabs into Persicaria's right shoulder. Her sword arm is rendered powerless and bright red operands gush from her wound.

spans.text: The blow stabs into Persicaria's right shoulder. Her sword arm is rendered powerless and bright red operands gush from her wound.

units.rawText: So you took the opportunity to swap positions... clever, aren't we?
units.displayText: So you took the opportunity to swap positions... clever, aren't we?

spans.text: So you took the opportunity to swap positions... clever, aren't we?

units.rawText: She looks behind Persicaria at Eos, who is panting lightly after being driven into a corner by Alcyone's hail of arrows.
units.displayText: She looks behind Persicaria at Eos, who is panting lightly after being driven into a corner by Alcyone's hail of arrows.

spans.text: She looks behind Persicaria at Eos, who is panting lightly after being driven into a corner by Alcyone's hail of arrows.

units.rawText: I know you're worried about Eos' operands, but don't you think incapacitating yourself just to cover her isn't a worthwhile tradeoff, Persicaria?
units.displayText: I know you're worried about Eos' operands, but don't you think incapacitating yourself just to cover her isn't a worthwhile tradeoff, Persicaria?

spans.text: I know you're worried about Eos' operands, but don't you think incapacitating yourself just to cover her isn't a worthwhile tradeoff, Persicaria?

units.rawText: I don't think so.
units.displayText: I don't think so.

spans.text: I don't think so.

units.rawText: A familiar smile blossoms on the pink-haired Doll's face.
units.displayText: A familiar smile blossoms on the pink-haired Doll's face.

spans.text: A familiar smile blossoms on the pink-haired Doll's face.

units.rawText: —After all, I'm not her.
units.displayText: —After all, I'm not her.

spans.text: —After all,
I'm not her.

units.rawText: In the next moment, a starlight shaft at the end of a fingertip pierces her core.
units.displayText: In the next moment, a starlight shaft at the end of a fingertip pierces her core.

spans.text: In the next moment, a starlight shaft at the end of a fingertip pierces her core.

units.rawText: But... how...
units.displayText: But... how...

spans.text: But... how...

units.rawText: The face of the Doll in Electra's field of vision returns to the one she knows, as Eos slowly pulls back a blood-stained fingertip.
units.displayText: The face of the Doll in Electra's field of vision returns to the one she knows, as Eos slowly pulls back a blood-stained fingertip.

spans.text: The face of the Doll in Electra's field of vision returns to the one she knows, as Eos slowly pulls back a blood-stained fingertip.

units.rawText: I knew you'd be wary of the same move if it was used twice, and I knew you'd follow your instincts in a fight...
units.displayText: I knew you'd be wary of the same move if it was used twice, and I knew you'd follow your instincts in a fight...

spans.text: I knew you'd be wary of the same move if it was used twice, and I knew you'd follow your instincts in a fight...

units.rawText: I'm sorry I had to trick you like this, Electra. Once this is over, I'll restore your Sacred Canon and explain everything to you.
units.displayText: I'm sorry I had to trick you like this, Electra. Once this is over, I'll restore your Sacred Canon and explain everything to you.

spans.text: I'm sorry I had to trick you like this, Electra. Once this is over, I'll restore your Sacred Canon and explain everything to you.

units.rawText: ...So until then, please sleep well.
units.displayText: ...So until then, please sleep well.

spans.text: ...So until then, please sleep well.

units.rawText: Eos turns away, unable to bear the sight of her friend dying before her eyes yet again.
units.displayText: Eos turns away, unable to bear the sight of her friend dying before her eyes yet again.

spans.text: Eos turns away, unable to bear the sight of her friend dying before her eyes yet again.

units.rawText: Electra! Are you alright?
units.displayText: Electra! Are you alright?

spans.text: Electra! Are you alright?

units.rawText: ...Don't forget who you're facing.
units.displayText: ...Don't forget who you're facing.

spans.text: ...Don't forget who you're facing.

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts an arrow out of the air, then closes on her in the blink of an eye and sends Alcyone flying into a wall with a side slash.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts an arrow out of the air, then closes on her in the blink of an eye and sends Alcyone flying into a wall with a side slash.

spans.text: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts an arrow out of the air, then closes on her in the blink of an eye and sends Alcyone flying into a wall with a side slash.

units.rawText: <size=40>It's over for you!</size>
units.displayText: It's over for you!

spans.text: It's over for you!

units.rawText: Starlight falls from the sky, accurately piercing Alcyone's core. Before she can react, her small body collapses unconscious to the ground.
units.displayText: Starlight falls from the sky, accurately piercing Alcyone's core. Before she can react, her small body collapses unconscious to the ground.

spans.text: Starlight falls from the sky, accurately piercing Alcyone's core. Before she can react, her small body collapses unconscious to the ground.

units.rawText: After seeing her enemy is not moving, the pink-haired Doll falls to one knee.
units.displayText: After seeing her enemy is not moving, the pink-haired Doll falls to one knee.

spans.text: After seeing her enemy is not moving, the pink-haired Doll falls to one knee.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah...

spans.text: Hah... Hah...

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: I'm fine. Come on, let's head over to the Professor's side.
units.displayText: I'm fine. Come on, let's head over to the Professor's side.

spans.text: I'm fine. Come on, let's head over to the Professor's side.

units.rawText: Alright.
units.displayText: Alright.

spans.text: Alright.

units.rawText: In the end, Eos resists the urge to ask about Persicaria's wounds and helps support her over to the closed door.
units.displayText: In the end, Eos resists the urge to ask about Persicaria's wounds and helps support her over to the closed door.

spans.text: In the end, Eos resists the urge to ask about Persicaria's wounds and helps support her over to the closed door.

units.rawText: <color=orange>It's not... over... yet...</color>
units.displayText: It's not... over... yet...

spans.text: It's not... over... yet...

units.rawText: The puppet fragments on the ground crawl toward Electra like they have a will of their own.
units.displayText: The puppet fragments on the ground crawl toward Electra like they have a will of their own.

spans.text: The puppet fragments on the ground crawl toward Electra like they have a will of their own.

units.rawText: But I shattered her core, how is this...
units.displayText: But I shattered her core, how is this...

spans.text: But I shattered her core, how is this...

units.rawText: Don't think... you can kill us so easily...
units.displayText: Don't think... you can kill us so easily...

spans.text: Don't think... you can kill us so easily...

units.rawText: The fragments piece themselves together and lift Electra up, slowly putting her body together.
units.displayText: The fragments piece themselves together and lift Electra up, slowly putting her body together.

spans.text: The fragments piece themselves together and lift Electra up, slowly putting her body together.

units.rawText: If it doesn't work, then I'll do it again!
units.displayText: If it doesn't work, then I'll do it again!

spans.text: If it doesn't work, then I'll do it again!

units.rawText: Persicaria summons up her operands and directs them at Electra, but the purple beam is deflected by a greatsword that lands in its path just before it hits.
units.displayText: Persicaria summons up her operands and directs them at Electra, but the purple beam is deflected by a greatsword that lands in its path just before it hits.

spans.text: Persicaria summons up her operands and directs them at Electra, but the purple beam is deflected by a greatsword that lands in its path just before it hits.

units.rawText: So he broke free of it, huh...
units.displayText: So he broke free of it, huh...

spans.text: So he broke free of it, huh...

units.rawText: ...I finally understand why you and <cmdr> betrayed Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: ...I finally understand why you and {교수} betrayed Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: ...I finally understand why you and
betrayed Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: His face is twisted with anger as he levels his greatsword at Persicaria.
units.displayText: His face is twisted with anger as he levels his greatsword at Persicaria.

spans.text: His face is twisted with anger as he levels his greatsword at Persicaria.

units.rawText: To think you'd draw on the power of the Entropy... <color=red>Persicaria, you are a Daemon!</color>
units.displayText: To think you'd draw on the power of the Entropy... Persicaria, you are a Daemon!

spans.text: To think you'd draw on the power of the Entropy...
Persicaria, you are a Daemon!

units.rawText: If you were being deceived by a Daemon, then everything makes sense!
units.displayText: If you were being deceived by a Daemon, then everything makes sense!

spans.text: If you were being deceived by a Daemon, then everything makes sense!

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll is about to retort, but her friend gently pulls down her trembling fingers.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll is about to retort, but her friend gently pulls down her trembling fingers.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll is about to retort, but her friend gently pulls down her trembling fingers.

units.rawText: It's alright. I trust that you're a friend of ours.
units.displayText: It's alright. I trust that you're a friend of ours.

spans.text: It's alright. I trust that you're a friend of ours.

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: As Eos helps her up, Persicaria tightens her grip on her sword.
units.displayText: As Eos helps her up, Persicaria tightens her grip on her sword.

spans.text: As Eos helps her up, Persicaria tightens her grip on her sword.

units.rawText: If they really couldn't be killed, then Atlas wouldn't have blocked that attack for Electra.
units.displayText: If they really couldn't be killed, then Atlas wouldn't have blocked that attack for Electra.

spans.text: If they really couldn't be killed, then Atlas wouldn't have blocked that attack for Electra.

units.rawText: We must have missed something. Do they come back to life after a certain amount of time? Is there a certain amount of times they can come back to life?
units.displayText: We must have missed something. Do they come back to life after a certain amount of time? Is there a certain amount of times they can come back to life?

spans.text: We must have missed something. Do they come back to life after a certain amount of time? Is there a certain amount of times they can come back to life?

units.rawText: I don't know either of those... But time is one thing we do not have.
units.displayText: I don't know either of those... But time is one thing we do not have.

spans.text: I don't know either of those... But time is one thing we do not have.

units.rawText: She looks at Electra and Atlas. The rage surrounding them fills her with caution.
units.displayText: She looks at Electra and Atlas. The rage surrounding them fills her with caution.

spans.text: She looks at Electra and Atlas. The rage surrounding them fills her with caution.

units.rawText: The puppets who were struck down before this rise in response to Electra's command, surrounding the pair despite their tattered state.
units.displayText: The puppets who were struck down before this rise in response to Electra's command, surrounding the pair despite their tattered state.

spans.text: The puppets who were struck down before this rise in response to Electra's command, surrounding the pair despite their tattered state.

units.rawText: So you have chosen fellowship with the Daemons... In that case, that is just one more reason to exterminate you!
units.displayText: So you have chosen fellowship with the Daemons... In that case, that is just one more reason to exterminate you!

spans.text: So you have chosen fellowship with the Daemons... In that case, that is just one more reason to exterminate you!
